evals.prompt: Plan only. An imported document hierarchy supports leaf/group operations, moves, shared references and deep untrusted input. Explain tree versus DAG contracts, cycle checks, failed reparenting, traversal/aggregation limits and destruction ownership.
evals.expected_output: Explicit identity/sharing rules, atomic moves, bounded traversal and owned resource lifetimes.
assertions: Distinguishes tree ownership from shared graph references and repeated contribution.
Prevents cycles and failed moves from corrupting parent links.
Bounds depth/work and separates detach from destruction.

evals.prompt: Conceptual only. Should a flat list sum use a Composite hierarchy? Can an empty authorization AND-group automatically allow access because all zero conditions are true? Explain the smallest structures and policy requirements.
evals.expected_output: Direct aggregation for a flat list; explicit security semantics for empty permission groups.
assertions: Rejects unnecessary hierarchy for a flat list.
Does not adopt mathematical empty-group identity as implicit authorization policy.
